snippet.title: Scramble: Battle of Britain | Campaign Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready to step into the cockpit and lead your squadron through the most defining months of WWII in Scramble: Battle of Britain’s first-ever single-player campaign.

As a Royal Air Force Squadron Leader, you’ll guide your pilots through the brutal reality of the Battle of Britain: dogfights, exhaustion, loss, and hard-won triumph.
Manage morale, stamina, and readiness as the Luftwaffe’s relentless raids push your squadron to its limits. Your pilots evolve with every mission, gaining experience, suffering injuries, and carrying scars, both physical and emotional.

This isn’t about changing history.
The Channel Defense Campaign tells your story: a personal tale of survival, leadership, and humanity in the face of overwhelming odds. Every victory and every loss shapes a living chronicle of courage, just as it did for “the Few.”
